LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.IntroductionContent:
[New Buttons]

Storage Zone - Invert
A new "Invert" button between "Clear All" and "Allow All" flips the allow/disallow state of every item in one click. Filter statuses are not affected.

Storage Zone - Expand/Collapse One Level
Two arrow buttons beside the search bar expand or collapse the item category tree one level at a time, avoiding the lag of expanding all categories at once.

Storage Zone - Paste Settings
Right-click the "Paste Settings" gizmo to access two overlay modes in addition to vanilla overwrite:
 · Add Allowed (OR): currently disallowed + clipboard allowed → allowed
 · Add Disallowed (AND): currently allowed + clipboard disallowed → disallowed
HP and quality ranges remain unchanged for these special paste operations.

Policy Management - Copy/Paste
Outfit and food policy dialogs now include Copy and Paste buttons, each with an independent clipboard. Paste offers Overwrite, Add Allowed, and Add Disallowed modes.

Policy Management - Advanced Filter
Outfit and food policy dialogs now include an "Advanced Filter" button that opens the filter-component dialog. The preview is context-aware: apparel policies show only apparel items; food policies show only items with Nutrition > 0.

[New Filters]

This mod adds 10 SpecialThingFilter workers in 5 complementary pairs:
 · Perishable / Non-Perishable — whether refrigeration is needed
 · Deteriorating / Non-Deteriorating — whether it degrades outdoors
 · Has Quality / No Quality — whether it has quality grades
 · Has Hit Points / No Hit Points — whether it has durability
 · Non-Stackable / Stackable — stack limit is 1 or 2+
All filters are based on static ThingDef properties for predictable results.

[Filter Category]

A new "Filter" category at the top of the storage item tree shows filters in one place. By default it holds the filters of this mod and of the base game. Filters from other mods stay where those mods put them; you can select each one on the "Filter Settings" page of the mod settings.

[Apply Filter]

The "Apply" button in the filter category pushes each disallowed filter down to individual items (disallowed filter → disallow matching items) and then re-allows the filter. Only static filters take part. Set the scope on the "Filter Settings" page.

[Filter Settings]

The "Filter Settings" page lists every loaded filter by source: base game and DLC first, then this mod, then other mods by name. Each filter has three options:
 · Type — A static filter reads only fixed properties of the item type (for example perishable, stack limit). A dynamic filter reads the state of each single item (for example tainted apparel). Static filters are available as Filter Worker options in the advanced filter and are hidden from its preview list. Dynamic filters stay in the preview list. The type of base-game filters and of this mod's filters is fixed. The type of other mods' filters is detected automatically and you can change it.
 · Move to group — Show the filter in the "Filter" category at the top. Filters that the game never shows are gray.
 · Apply — Include the filter in the "Apply" button. Static filters only.

When a loaded save has new filters from other mods, you get a letter. Use the option at the top of this page to turn the letter off.

[Match Property Settings]

The "Match Property Settings" page lists the properties that numeric filters and enum filters can select in the advanced filter, in the sections "Numeric" and "Enum". Left-click a row to enable or disable it. A disabled property is hidden from the advanced filter. Built-in properties can only be enabled or disabled. You can add custom properties (type, display name, target path). Right-click a disabled custom property to delete it.
LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.FilterTargetsDesc: Properties that numeric filters and enum filters can select in the advanced filter. Left-click a row to enable or disable it. Right-click a disabled custom property to delete it.
LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.TargetDuplicate: A target with the same type and XPath already exists.
LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.FilterSettingsDesc: A static filter reads only fixed properties of the item type. "Apply" can write it into per-item permissions, and the advanced filter offers it as a Filter Worker option. A dynamic filter reads the state of each single item and stays in the item list of the advanced filter. Hover a row or a column title for details.
LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.ColumnKindTip:
Static: the result depends only on the item type.
Dynamic: the result depends on the state of each single item.

The type of base-game filters and of this mod's filters is fixed. The type of other mods' filters is detected automatically. Click the button to change it.
LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.ColumnMoveTip:
When ticked, the filter is shown in the "Filter" category at the top of the storage item tree.

Scope: the filter moves only when its own category is the root category of the current storage tree or a parent of it. A filter in a sub-category stays in place.

Note: if another mod draws extra UI next to its own filter, that UI can stop showing after the move.

Gray filters are never shown by the game and cannot be ticked.
LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.ColumnApplyTip: When ticked, the "Apply" button of the storage UI processes this filter: it writes a disallowed filter into per-item permissions and then re-allows the filter.\n\nStatic filters only.
LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.FilterTipNotConfigurable: The definition of this filter makes it not configurable. The game does not show it in item lists.
LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.FilterTipNoMatch: This filter matches no storable item. The game hides it in every storage UI.
LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.TargetRowTip: Left-click: enable or disable. A disabled property is hidden from the advanced filter.
LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.TargetRowTipDelete: Right-click when disabled: delete this property.
LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.NotifyNewFilters: Send a letter when a loaded save has new filters
LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.NotifyNewFiltersTip: When filters from other mods appear for the first time, one letter lists them. When this option is off, the filters are still recorded on the "Filter Settings" page.
LanguageData.UR.BetterFilter.NewFiltersLetterText:
[UR] Better Filter found these new filters from other mods:

{0}

New filters stay in place and are not included in "Apply". Go to Options → Mod Settings → [UR] Better Filter Settings → "Filter Settings" to change the type, the move to the "Filter" group, and the "Apply" scope.

You can turn this letter off on the "Introduction" page of the same settings.
